definitions.full: H2427. chil חִיל noun masculine Exod 15:14 a writhing, anguish ; — ׳ח absolute 15:14 5 t. — 1 writhing (contortions of fear) Exod 15:14 (|| verb רָגַז ). 2 anguish , always in simile כַּיּוֺלֵדָה Psa 48:7 (allied kings against Jerusalem); Zion, before Assyrians Micah 4:9 ; before Scythians or Chaldeans Jer 6:24 (|| צָרָה ), = 50:43 (of king of Babylon; || צָרָה ); 22:23 (|| חבלים q. v.) חִילָה noun feminine anguish , Job 6:10 .
